canonical_project: QST Data Centre 1 (Riyadh) - 300 MW MCIT program
notes: QST signed an MCIT agreement for 300 MW (six 50 MW facilities) across Riyadh, Dammam, Jeddah, NEOM by 2026; CST registry lists 'Quantum Switch Tamasuk Data Centre 1' (Riyadh); DCD reports ground broken on two facilities and w.media/MEED report first-phase construction advancing. 300 MW is program-level capacity, not a single building.
